title: How you get paid
intro: Here's how money works for suppliers on Shopinbos.

steps.caption: Coming to your bank
steps.vo: Open Money. Coming to your bank is your share of orders the shops have paid for. It reaches your bank once delivery is confirmed.

steps.caption: Straight to your bank
steps.vo: Customers pay at checkout, and your share is sent straight to your bank. Shopinbos doesn't hold your money. Tap Change to use a different bank.

steps.caption: See every payment
steps.vo: Under Recent, you can see each order that was paid, and the bank it went to.

steps.caption: Ready to get paid
steps.vo: In your Shopinbos Wallet, check you're receiving payments: choose where we send your money, and verify your CAC or BN business registration.

outro: That's it. You're ready to sell with Shopinbos. Start easy, sell smarter.
